4675.title: Persisted task comments are gated on agent delivery
4675.rootCauseOneLine: The persisted-comment RPC awaits thread delivery before returning or publishing its initial change event.
4675.proposedFix: Publish after insert; detach RPC delivery while retaining explicit CLI waiting; update the count and publish again on completion.
4675.caveats: Controlled RPC reproduction, not a live-server latency benchmark. Comment-list optimization was not tested or changed.
